purpose: Bound the inspection-centre data before it is used by the generic outdoor LH2 PRISM chain.

timestamped_process_state_screening.reason: The audit found timestamped process and sequence columns, but not a complete reviewed tag/unit/calibration map.

explicit_operating_mode_and_hazop_diagno.reason: Explicit modes and a reconstructed state adapter may select a HAZOP branch; this does not turn normal rows into an accident.

failure_frequency.reason: Normal-operation time series do not provide a counted failure population, exposure denominator, or qualified event-frequency record.

independent_physical_validation.reason: The source package is not an independent accident-release validation campaign.

promotion_gates.reason: Use the files for state/HAZOP diagnostics only until source-owner unit, tag, calibration, identity, and accident-release evidence are separately reviewed.

allowed_uses: reconstruct an explicitly labelled state frame
pass an explicit operating mode to a HAZOP diagnostic gate
exercise the fail-closed provider/consequence interface with a separately identified diagnostic packet
forbidden_implicit_promotions: infer a leak size or release duration from pressure or temperature alone
learn annual failure frequency from alarms or normal-operation samples
treat reconstructed/training data as independent accident measurements
promote a provider packet or facility IR/F-N result from this source inventory
